title: Book Two · Chapter 104: One Picture
story:
Mei places her finished picture between two heavy books. Ronan and Jun stand across the table from her.

“Do not move the books yet,” she says. “The paper wants to curl.”

Her picture begins at the main gate. A thick line runs past the long building and up the broad steps. At the passage, the line divides. One arrow reaches the reading room. The other reaches the materials room.

Jun moves his finger along the line. He does not touch the paper.

“This is clear.”

Ronan wants a small boy beside the gate. He starts to ask, but Mei is already opening her own work.

“Can we use it on the middle page?” he asks instead.

“Yes. Keep the two room names.”

They put a plain sheet under the picture and try the fold. The main gate disappears into the middle.

Jun opens it again. “That will not work.”

Ronan turns the picture sideways. Now the words run up the page.

Mei looks at him. “Pupils have necks. They should not need to turn them like that.”

Jun laughs. Ronan laughs, too. They find a larger sheet for the cover and leave the picture flat inside it. The guide will have one fold at the outside edge.

On the back, Jun writes a simple book list. Ronan writes the opening time below it. He presses hard on Wednesday. The pencil line is dark.

Miss Wu comes to look. She reads the route first, then asks Jun to explain it.

Jun gives her the whole route. At the passage he stops and names both rooms.

“Useful,” she says. “Who checked the times?”

“I did,” Ronan says.

She looks at him. “With the teacher?”

“Yes.”

He answers faster this time. He still has not asked the teacher about Wednesday.

Miss Wu puts a small mark beside the line. “We can show the sample on Friday. You can introduce the guide, Ronan. Jun can take the first questions.”

Ronan smiles and stands straighter. He looks at the plain front cover. Now the title seems too small.

After Miss Wu leaves, Jun pushes the sample toward him.

“You need to say we both made it.”

“I will. And Mei made the picture.”

“Only that picture,” Mei says. “I do not know about the times.”

“Of course,” Ronan says.

He copies their names onto the cover. His own name goes first. He stares at it, then moves Jun's name onto the same line. Mei's name stays directly under her picture.

At the end of the afternoon, he carries the sample in both hands. He likes seeing their names on the front. But on the way home, he keeps thinking about the time on the back. He still has not checked it.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

curl＝卷起；divide＝分开；introduce＝介绍；sample＝样本。

## 理解问题

1. 他们怎样解决折页遮住大门的问题？
2. Miss Wu为什么以为时间已经核对过？Ronan实际核对了吗？

## 读句子

**Jun / opens it / again.** Jun／再次打开／它。
